name: Pharaoh (Exodus)
title: Ruler of Egypt
summary: The Pharaoh in Exodus is the Egyptian king who refused to let the Israelites go, despite ten terrible plagues. His hardened heart is an example of resistance against God. Finally, he let the people go but pursued them and perished with his army in the Red Sea.

keyEvents.title: Refused to Let Israel Go
keyEvents.description: When Moses asked Pharaoh to let the people go, he refused and increased the labor burden on the Israelites.

keyEvents.title: The Ten Plagues
keyEvents.description: God sent ten plagues upon Egypt, but Pharaoh hardened his heart again and again.

keyEvents.title: The Final Plague
keyEvents.description: After all the firstborn in Egypt died, Pharaoh finally let Israel go.

keyEvents.title: Pursuit and Destruction
keyEvents.description: Pharaoh regretted it and pursued Israel, but his army drowned in the Red Sea.
